CPMG detection can be implemented in MQ NMR experiments for static powder solids, and the sensitivity of the experiments can be improved significantly.

the MQ NMR experiments employing the CPMGs in detection are a viable option for the studies of static powder samples, which can be used for the studies of the systems with a very large CSA and/or very short spin-spin relaxation times.
